| Multiplayer/Session | `src/ServerScriptService/Foundation/Session/SessionContextService.luau` | 📋 Contract Defined | Up-to-six-player session assumptions, player lifecycle, downed/revive state. Implementation pending migration. |

| Resource Definitions | `src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Survival/{ResourceDefinitions,ToolDefinitions}.luau` | 📋 Defined | Gathering and tool contracts |
